# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Inspected the latest approved review feedback for the save-schema migration work and made no additional code changes. The remaining review notes were unrelated branch-level follow-ups or accepted design choices rather than actionable defects in the migration implementation, so I left `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs`, `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs` unchanged and reran the focused validation.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest save-migration approval notes and rechecked the touched save-schema files to determine whether any new fixes were actually requested.
2. [Skipped] Apply additional save-schema code edits for new review findings.
3. [Completed] Reran focused validation for the save/load migration path and `tank_core` test-target clippy after confirming no further code changes were warranted.

## Validation Evidence

- `git diff --stat -- crates/tank_core/src/save.rs crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs crates/tank_core/src/types/actions.rs` returned no changes, confirming this apply-fixes pass was a no-op on the save-schema files.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed: 18 tests passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.

## Outstanding Risks

- Known unrelated branch regression carried forward from prior review: `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population hatch_produces_juveniles -- --exact` was previously failing on this branch with TAN around 2.169 mg/L and no juvenile hatch; this apply-fixes pass did not address or revalidate it.
- Known unrelated architectural issue carried forward from prior review: `Engine::step_hours` still calls `enforce_invariants(&mut self.state)` before returning some invariant errors, so a rejected step can still mutate live state.
